measurement_contract.location: Oracle aarch64 isolated exact-image namespace; diagnostic examples
measurement_contract.warmups: 100 by profile_support for measured stages in these screens; special getFeatures/HostHints helpers were not sampled here
measurement_contract.time: ns_per_op is each window mean over3000 operations; the index reports median and range of three means, not latency p50/p95/p99.
measurement_contract.counters: allocs/reallocs/requested_bytes are one separate counting-allocator call after timing; requested bytes are cumulative allocation requests, not live memory/RSS.
measurement_contract.direction: lower/higher is numerical direction; all unfavorable and unchanged-control observations retained. Three-window consistency and range overlap are descriptive, not significance tests.
measurement_contract.pairing: Window numbers recovered from CSV directory prefixes; derived array order must not be assumed to pair rounds.
scope_limits: No ubus transport, caller/dependency CPU, or physical AX3000T latency acceptance in these profiles.
Do not sum candidate percentages, stitch separate screens into one causal gain, or relabel an actual combination as isolated change.

retention_policy.comparisons: Keep every comparison with any higher candidate median (time or allocation counter), plus representative positive/control cases. No observed median regression is discarded.
retention_policy.rounds: candidate_ns/comparator_ns and round_directions use round order1,2,3 reconstructed from original CSV directory names.
retention_policy.ranges: candidate_median_range_ns and comparator_median_range_ns are [median_of_round_means, minimum_round_mean, maximum_round_mean]. These are not latency quantiles.
retention_policy.counters: counter_medians use [comparator,candidate]. Per-round allocator counters and all omitted microcases remain in the SHA-identified source CSVs.
retention_policy.source_lookup: A result group screen/label/profile_kind resolves to private/rpcd-20260928/profile-screen-<screen>/<round>-<label>-<profile_kind>/<profile_kind>-profile.csv. Every referenced CSV is listed with SHA256 below.
retention_policy.incremental: Same-screen contrasts only; no addition of independent percentages and no relabeling combinations as isolated deltas.

candidates.source_title: perf(uci): reuse locked file read buffer in parse cache
candidates.mechanism: Move the complete locked file-read Vec into ReadCache; reuse bounded scratch instead of allocating another read Vec and copying into prefetch storage.

decision.reason: Rejected as a final standalone variant, retained as a mechanism only after U6 combination comparison. Screen02 large UCI increased 5.43%; screen04 U6 vs U5 favored restoring it. Standalone direction cannot predict its combination effect.

limitations: No metadata-only hit: current bytes must be read through EOF under the same lock.
Base parse+spare <=128KiB and scratch <=32KiB; large scratch allocations are dropped.
The standalone large-config slowdown was observed, not causally attributed.

Explicit reuse helper must be updated when model fields are added.

candidates.source_title: perf(rpcd): retain owned Blob buffers for UCI replies
candidates.mechanism: Store BlobBuf in rpcd Payloads::Blob and borrow payload() (the bytes after its four-byte head) through single/iter/Index; eliminate into_payload overlapping relocation for UCI get/state.

decision.reason: Owned Blob mechanism retained in U6; U5 superseded after screen04 U6 showed small consistent query improvement and one fewer allocation.

limitations: Four logical head bytes remain until Reply drop; backing capacity unchanged because drain never shrank the original Vec.
No pool, extra allocation, shared ubus change, unsafe code, or string-NUL contract relaxation.
Later ubus framing costs remain; this removes one relocation, not every transport copy.

candidates.source_title: perf(rpcd): skip unrelated sorted ACL prefix ranges
candidates.mechanism: Use the existing linear scan for <=8 ACLs; for larger sorted ACL vectors binary-search candidate prefixes and skip ranges that cannot prefix the object, preserving existing fnmatch.

decision.reason: Range-skipping mechanism retained only with S3. Standalone S1 rejected as final because first-rule and leading-wildcard cases pay avoidable search work.

limitations: Late/absent lookup gains do not describe first-rule authorization.
No persistent index/cache or grant/revoke reordering; complex libc matcher remains authoritative.
Exact C sort_len is zero-initialized without assignment, so this is not a literal reproduction of an effective C prefix filter.

candidates.source_title: perf(rpcd): reuse list path storage across entries
candidates.mechanism: Reuse the checked PathBuf by push/pop for each file.list entry, including metadata-error continue; preserve full-path lstat/readlink/stat sequence.

decision.reason: Selected as a small allocation reduction. Screen02 list mean improves only0.30% while stat rises2.03%; do not advertise allocation savings as large end-to-end latency gains.

limitations: No syscall reduction or pathname race-boundary change.
Path capacity retained only within one response, bounded by its largest entry.
Stat handler does not use the changed list loop; observed stat difference remains unassigned.

stop_reason: Thirteen mechanism variants and corrected compositions were compared. H1 passed the canonical, 36 effective functional/recovery, nine physical timing-window and ten-cycle resource checks. Accept the measured UCI/ACL gains with explicit c4/list-tail/devices, CLI and RSS costs in RPCD_20260928_RESEARCH.md. No all-workload, global-optimum or production-deployment claim; unimplemented directions remain hypotheses, not disproved opportunities.
